decisionsTitle: «Ambasador» beside «Elită»; «Șterge» on an ended invitation and on a list of the sponsors' register; the registrations above the page's folds; the shut door's sentence, friendlier or the event's own; the volunteers' own numbers; a runner turned volunteer and a volunteer turned runner; and the list for a raffle (amending §897, §910, §647, §929, §943, §946, §906, §548, §754, §67, §289 and §872)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-14, with a picture of an event's registrations list and of one row of it — an invitation, «Invitație retrasă», whose only press was «Vezi invitația»:** "pe langa Elite, adauga si categoria de \"Ambasadori\" ca sa putem decite pe cine premiem si pe cine nu", and: "Si mai am o problema, am o invitatie retreasa, vreau sa o pot sterge!". Asked what the mark «Ambasador» should do on a registration, he chose: «Ca «Elită», fără BIB special».

**Where it stood.** The club had one category of invited runner, «Elită» (§897): a mark on a registration that prints its bib as an elite's and, since §910, brings two ticks — «Apare în clasament», which unticked runs the result hors concours, and «Apare pe site», which unticked hides the name the runner's own tick shows. A club ambassador who runs the race had no mark at all, so on «Clasament» and at «Premii» nothing told the club whose result it was looking at. And an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn by the club, or past its deadline — stayed on the list and in the «Invitații» panel until the retention job took it, thirty days after it ended (§647): the Administrator who withdrew one sent by mistake kept reading it for a month.

**Decision — «Ambasador».** A second mark on a registration, `registrations.ambassador`, set from the same places as «Elită»: the row's «⋮» on the registrations list («Marchează ca ambasador» / «Nu mai e ambasador»), and a one-press «Nu mai e ambasador» on each line of a new closed fold «Ambasadori» beside «Elite», which lists the event's ambassadors by name in every state, each with its state, its number, «și elită» when it wears both marks, and what the two ticks hide of it. It is the Administrator's, at any time and in any state, asserted at the action and again in the service (BR-REQ-060-01); the Organizer reads the chip and the fold and is offered no press. It asks no question, as the elite's mark does not: it emails nobody, the same menu undoes it. The trail: `registration.ambassador_marked` / `registration.ambassador_unmarked`, the new value alone.

**What the mark is.** A label, and the two ticks it brings. The label changes nothing of the registration: not its state, its place, its race number, a count, the kits, the queue or an email — the allocator and the capacity formula never read it — and not the bib, which prints as any other, the number where the number goes (that is «fără BIB special»). The backoffice says it: the chip «Ambasador» on the list and on the registration's page, and — so the club can decide whom it awards — beside the runner's name on every registered line of «Clasament» and on the podium rows of «Premii», where «Elită» is now said the same way; a line the tick left out of the ranking says by which mark («ambasador în afara clasamentului», an elite's as before). Nothing public says it: the published results, the participants' list, the desk, the emails, the bibs, the registrations' Excel and CSV and the lists given to sponsors carry neither a field nor a word of it, and a guard lists every file that may name the mark. The one file that holds it is the person's own data («Toate datele unei persoane», the answer to an access request), which carries every column of their registration.

**The two ticks are the registration's one pair.** «Apare în clasament» and «Apare pe site» are §910's columns and §910's presses, unchanged in what they do; what changes is when they count: while the registration is marked «Elită» **or** «Ambasador». So an ambassador unticked from «Apare în clasament» is out of the public results, of everybody's position and so of «Premii», its line kept on the backoffice's «Clasament» as «în afara clasamentului»; and unticked from «Apare pe site» it reads on the public list and in the published results as a runner who did not tick «Vreau să apar» — «Participant (nume ascuns)», still counted. A staff tick only ever hides: nobody is shown whom their own tick does not show. The ticks are offered in the row's «⋮» and on the registration's page under whichever mark it wears; a registration with both marks has one pair, and taking one mark off leaves the ticks counting under the other. The ticks' server refusal (`ELITE_NOT_MARKED`) now refuses only a registration that wears neither. Putting the ambassador's mark on or taking it off re-ranks the stored results in the same transaction, and tells the public pages after it, only where that changes what the ticks do — on a registration that is not an elite and has a tick unticked.

**Decision — «Șterge» on an ended invitation.** An Administrator deletes an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn, or past its deadline — from its line in the «Invitații» panel and from its row on the registrations list, behind a question that names the person and says nobody is emailed. The row goes with its link (a link already in somebody's inbox stops working, as after the retention job); the trail keeps `event.invitation_deleted` on the event with the invitation's id and how it ended, never a name or an address. The server refuses an invitation still open — it holds a place, and «Retrage» is the press that gives the place back, through the allocator — and one that became a registration, which goes with its registration (`INVITATION_NOT_ENDED`, said in words). One past its deadline that the job has not stamped yet is ended first by the event's own sweep, so its place is offered to the line exactly as the job would have offered it; that is why the press is an emailing press, with its own cause. The Organizer is offered no «Șterge» and is refused at the action and in the service. The retention job is unchanged: what nobody deletes still goes thirty days after it ended.

**The owner again, 2026-11-15, with three pictures** — the fold «Liste date sponsorilor» with its three rows, the stack of closed folds on an event's registrations page, and the event's card on the listing with «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.» framed in red: "Si vreau sa pot sterge (hard delete) si faza asta, pt ca am generat din greseaa!"; "Si faza asta cu descarcarea listei as vrea sa fie sub seciuneatiunea \"cine s-a inscris\" chiar sub \"cautare si iltrare\""; "si astea vreau sa fie sub \"cautare si filtrare\""; and "aici vreau sa scrie mai frumos sau sa pot customiza mesajul". Asked where the folds go against the table, he chose «Sub tabel»; asked about the sentence, «Text nou + mesaj propriu».

**Decision — «Șterge» on a list of «Liste date sponsorilor».** An Administrator deletes a list's record from the register, beside each row on both doors — an event's registrations page and «Newsletter» — behind a question that names the list by its recipient and day. The register is the trail's own rows (§929), so the press deletes that audit row for real: nothing of it is kept, not the recipient and not the registrations it named, and «Dată partenerilor» on the page of every registration the file held goes with it. What stays is one new row about the same event, `registrations.sponsor_list_record_deleted` — who deleted and when, and of the list only its moment, its count and its file. The statement names the export's action and entity type beside the id, so the id of any other row of the trail, posted by hand, deletes nothing. The Organizer, who may take the list and read the register, is offered no press and is refused at the action and in the service. The press comes back to the register it was pressed in, open on what is left.

**When the press is right, said in the dialog.** The notice promises that «pentru fiecare listă, clubul păstrează cui a dat-o și ce înscrieri a cuprins». A list made by mistake, which reached nobody, was given to nobody, and its row said otherwise to each person in it; deleting it corrects the record. A list that was given is another matter — the register is then the club's answer to «cui mi-ați dat datele?» — so the question says: «Șterge doar o listă făcută din greșeală, care n-a ajuns la nimeni.» The platform cannot know which it is; the Administrator answers for it. This is the one deletion by hand the audit trail takes (`AGENTS.md` §12.12 says so now); the retention job's three years are unchanged.

**Decision — the registrations first, everything else below the table.** On an event's registrations page the order is now: the toolbar, «Numere de concurs», «Cine s-a înscris», «Caută și filtrează», the table with its batch verbs — and below them «Lista pentru sponsori», «Invitații», «Lista internă (doar notițe)», «Elite», «Ambasadori», «Lista oficială de așteptare» and «Emailuri de trimis», in that order, each a closed fold that still opens by itself when something in it asks (a refusal, a save, messages waiting). The filter stays next to the rows it narrows. No fold changed its id, so «Invită pe email», the links from other pages and every press that comes back to its fold land as before. **Amends §946** in where «Lista pentru sponsori» stands (it stood first, above the bibs) and §943's page in the order of its folds; nothing else of either.

**Decision — the shut door's sentence.** While «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked (§906) the site said «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.» / “Registration on the site has been stopped by the organizers.” It now says «Înscrierile pe site sunt închise momentan.» / “Registration on the site is closed for now.” — on the card, on the event's page, on its register page, in its calendar entry, and in the email that tells a person their held place lapsed («…închise momentan. Dacă mai vrei să vii, scrie-ne din pagina de contact.»). And the club may write its own: «Mesaj cât înscrierile pe site sunt oprite (opțional)», one short line per language under the tick in the editor's «Perioada de înscriere» (`event_translations.paused_note`, plain text, at most 200 characters, with the editor's «Copiază și tradu»). Written, it is said in place of the platform's sentence on the card, the page, the register page and the calendar entry — the reader's language's own, never the other language's (§28). Both languages or neither (§352), whatever the tick says, since the strip stands beside the tick always; empty, the platform's sentence. It is kept, unread, while the door is open, so the next closing finds it; a series edit and a copy carry it with the door's switch; the event file carries it only when written, so a file of an event without one is the file the release before it reads. The emails keep the platform's sentence: they are not handed the event's words. The other shut door — «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» with nothing to join — keeps its own sentence.

**The owner a third time, 2026-11-15:** «aș vrea să pot să „transform" un alergător în voluntar și invers», «de asemenea și voluntarii trebuie să aibă un „Nr de concurs"», «pentru că vreau să fac o tombolă și trebuie să pot exporta toți voluntarii și toți participanții». Asked which numbers the volunteers get, he chose «Serie proprie» — a series of their own, from a number the club picks — and asked whether the five things above should go live first, «Nu încă, tot în #702».

**Decision — the volunteers' own numbers (amending §548 and §754).** An event gives its volunteers numbers only once the club says where they start: «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la», a box with its own save on the event's «Voluntari» card (`events.volunteer_bib_start`; empty is none). The start is refused at or below any number a runner of the event wears or may come to wear — a capped race's last number, the desk's spares, a number worn, retired or on the elite list (`VOLUNTEER_NUMBERS_IN_RACE_SERIES`) — so the two series never meet. A volunteer draws theirs when the organizers confirm them (`event_volunteers.bib_number`): the lowest free number from the start, under the event row's lock, the lock every race number is drawn under, so **one number is one person at an event** — a runner's draw and the desk's hand-typed number treat a volunteer's as worn, and a volunteer's draw steps over every number a runner, an elite line or a spare holds. Saving the start gives every volunteer already confirmed their number, in the order they were added; a person cancelled keeps theirs, retired; a deleted person's is kept from the trail and never drawn again; switching the series off stops the draws and takes no number back. Whoever manages the volunteers sets it (the Organizer and the Administrators), and the trail holds the old and the new start and a count, never a person. The number is a chip on the person («Nr. 500») and a column of the volunteers' CSV and Excel. A series of their own rather than the race's: the bibs of a capped race are numbered and printed ahead, and a volunteer confirmed in between would take a runner's number.

**Decision — «Transformă în voluntar» and «Transformă în alergător» (amending §67, §289 and §872).** A volunteer is still not a registration (§754), and neither press makes one into the other. Each is the two presses an Administrator would make by hand, in one transaction under the event row's lock, so the person is never on both lists or on neither (`volunteers/transform.ts`):

- **a runner turned volunteer**, from a closed fold on the registration's page: the registration is cancelled by the staff cancel — the one allocator, the place offered to the front of the waiting list — and its person entered on the event's volunteers by the volunteers' hand entry, with the role the Administrator chooses from the event's own, and confirmed, which draws their number. The entry carries the registered name, the address, the telephone number and the language; what the person answered for the same event — the date of birth, sex, city, the club-member tick, the shirt size — only while the privacy notice in force names the volunteers' answers (§765); never a place on a public list, which is the person's own tick. The question names both emails the person gets, «Înscriere anulată» and then «Rolul tău de voluntar», the freed place's offer, a printed bib that goes void (§311), and offers «Trimite emailul» for the person's two together; the offer to the next in line always goes. Refused with nothing written: a registration that can no longer be cancelled, a test one, a person under eighteen on the event's day — a minor volunteers with a parent's agreement (§768), which the hand entry asks — a role that is not the event's, an address already on the event's volunteers. It lands on the volunteer's own page;
- **a volunteer turned runner**, from a closed fold on the volunteer's page: the person is entered by the official waiting list's own entry (§872) — the relay tick (§33), the address vouched for, the one allocator: a counted free place with the declaration theirs to sign, or the back of the line, never ahead of anyone — under the two names the Administrator checks (the volunteers' list keeps one line), in the language the volunteer's row holds, and the volunteer is cancelled, keeping the row and its roles. Every refusal of that entry stands — after the start, a full line, the person already on the address — and a cancelled volunteer, or one the club typed without an address, is refused too. Nothing the person told the organizers as a volunteer is copied onto the registration: its answers and its declaration are the person's own. It lands on the registration's page.

Both are the Administrator's — the Organizer, who works the volunteers, is offered neither fold and refused by the server — because one half of each is a verb only the Administrator has (§289, §872). **A number never moves with the person**: the runner's stays retired with the cancelled registration, the volunteer's with the cancelled row, and each list draws its own. One trail row ties the two halves (`registration.became_volunteer`, on the registration's timeline; `volunteer.became_runner`), ids only, beside each verb's own row. «Confirmă» on a volunteer now takes the event's lock before the person's row, the order the transform takes them in, so two presses on one person wait in a line and never in a circle.

**Decision — «Lista pentru tombolă».** With one event chosen, the registrations list's toolbar has «Lista pentru tombolă (CSV)»: one file with everybody who wears a number there — a confirmed registration with a race number, a confirmed volunteer with a number of the volunteers' series — by the number, as three columns: the number, the name, «Alergător» or «Voluntar», in the reader's language. Never a registration that waits, is held, cancelled or a test one, a cancelled volunteer, anybody without a number or a line of the elite list (a name on a bib, nobody registered); and nothing else of a person. Whoever reads the registrations and works the volunteers takes it — the Organizer and the Administrators — asserted in the route and in the service; the download is recorded as the other exports are (§322), with the two counts and never a name (`event.raffle_list_exported`).

**Refused.** A bib of its own for ambassadors: the owner chose none. A second pair of ticks, or separate columns per mark: one runner is in the ranking or out of it, on the site or off it — two pairs could disagree about the same person. A public «Ambasadorii cursei» list or a word on the published results: the public list is a disclosure (BR-REQ-039-01) and nobody asked for one. Marking an ambassador out of the ranking by default: the mark alone moves nothing, the club unticks whom it means to. Deleting an open invitation in one press: it would give a counted place back outside the withdrawal's own path. Deleting an accepted one: that is a registration, and erasing a registration is its own audited verb. Keeping the deleted person's name in the trail: the trail names who deleted and what, as an erasure's does. A soft delete of a sponsors' list — a mark that hides the row: the owner asked for the row gone, and a record of a disclosure that never happened, kept in the trail, is still wrong for whoever reads the trail by hand. Letting the Organizer delete: a record of a list is not the taker's to remove. The folds between the filter and the table — the literal reading of «chiar sub „căutare și filtrare"»: offered, and the owner chose «Sub tabel». The new sentence alone, with no box: offered, and the owner chose both. One sentence for every event, in «Setări»: why the door is shut differs by event. The note in the emails: they would need the event's words at the send, for one sentence the platform's own already says. Keeping a runner's number on the volunteer they become: the cancelled registration's printed bib is void and its screen says to pull it from the pile (§311), which a volunteer wearing it would contradict — and the owner chose a series of their own. Numbering the volunteers from the race's series: see above. A third state or a row that is both a runner and a volunteer: a volunteer holds no place and signs no declaration, a registration does both. Copying a volunteer's answers onto the registration, or signing anything for them: the declaration and the answers are the person's (§67). A new email «Ai devenit voluntar»: the two emails that exist say it, each in its own words. Letting the Organizer transform: cancelling and the vouched entry are the Administrator's. Reopening a cancelled volunteer's row by itself when the same person is turned into a volunteer a second time: the hand entry's own rule is one row per address, and its sentence sends the Administrator to that row. The number printed on the volunteer's badge: not asked, and the badge carries no name by design (§764). An Excel file of the raffle list: three columns open in Excel as they are.

Migrations `0201_registration_ambassador` (one boolean column, `false` by default), `0202_event_paused_note` (one nullable text column) and `0203_volunteer_numbers` (`events.volunteer_bib_start` and `event_volunteers.bib_number`, both nullable, with their checks and a partial unique index per event), all expand only. No new dependency.
changelogLine: - **«Ambasador» beside «Elită», and «Șterge» on an ended invitation** — an Administrator marks a registration «Ambasador» from the list's «⋮»: a chip on the list, on the registration's page, in «Clasament» and at «Premii», a closed fold «Ambasadori» beside «Elite», the bib as any other, and the elite's two ticks — «Apare în clasament» (unticked: out of the ranking and of the awards) and «Apare pe site» — one pair whichever mark the registration wears; nothing public names the mark. An invitation that was withdrawn or ran past its deadline can be deleted, from the «Invitații» panel and from its row on the list, behind a question; an open one is withdrawn first. **Also:** a list for sponsors downloaded by mistake is deleted from «Liste date sponsorilor» by an Administrator, asked first, with «Dată partenerilor» on its registrations; on an event's registrations page «Cine s-a înscris», «Caută și filtrează» and the table come first, and «Lista pentru sponsori», «Invitații», «Lista internă», «Elite», «Ambasadori», «Lista oficială de așteptare» and «Emailuri de trimis» follow the table; and while «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked the site says «Înscrierile pe site sunt închise momentan.» — or the club's own sentence for the event, written in both languages under the tick. **And for volunteers:** an event gives its volunteers numbers of their own series — «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la», on the «Voluntari» card: each confirmed volunteer draws one, never a runner's, shown on the person and in the volunteers' CSV and Excel; an Administrator turns a runner into a volunteer («Transformă în voluntar», on the registration's page) or a volunteer into a runner («Transformă în alergător», on the volunteer's page) in one press, asked first — the cancellation and the waiting list's own entry, so no place is given or taken any other way; and «Lista pentru tombolă (CSV)» on an event's registrations list downloads every confirmed runner and volunteer who has a number. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an invitation that ended unaccepted — withdrawn, or past its deadline, stamped by the sweep or not — when an Administrator presses «Șterge» on its line of the «Invitații» panel or on its row of the registrations list and confirms the question, which names the person and says nobody is emailed, then the invitation and its link are deleted and `event.invitation_deleted` records the invitation's id and how it ended, never a name or an address; one past its deadline and not yet swept is first ended by the event's sweep, which offers its place to the line; an invitation still open, or one that became a registration, is refused in words (`INVITATION_NOT_ENDED`) and nothing is written; a second press finds no invitation (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration an Administrator marked «Ambasador» from the registrations list's «⋮» or unmarked from there or from the «Ambasadori» fold — at any time and in any state — then its bib prints as any other registration's and its state, place, race number and printed mark stay as they were, `countOccupied`, the kits, the registrations' summary and the places line count it as before, and no email is queued; a press that finds the mark already as asked writes nothing (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration marked «Ambasador», when an Administrator unticks its «Apare pe site», then the public list and the published results read it as one that did not tick «Vreau să apar pe lista de participanți» — an unnamed, counted row while confirmed — and a runner who did not tick is never shown, whatever the mark and the club's tick say; the tick counts while the registration is marked «Elită» or «Ambasador» and is inert under neither; and no public page, published result, email, desk screen, bib, registrations export or list given to sponsors carries the mark, as a field or as a word — the person's own data («Toate datele unei persoane») holds it, with every column of their registration (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a race with results, when an Administrator unticks «Apare în clasament» on a registration marked «Ambasador», then its result stays on «Clasament» as «în afara clasamentului» and is out of the public results, of every other runner's position — stored and read — and of «Premii», and comes back with the tick; the mark alone moves nothing; the one pair of ticks counts under either mark, so taking one of two marks off keeps the runner out and taking the last one off ranks them again in the same transaction; and the backoffice's «Clasament» and «Premii» say «Elită» and «Ambasador» beside the runner's name on a registered line, never on a line typed by hand (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the ambassador's mark, the pair of ticks on a registration that wears it, and «Șterge» on an ended invitation, then only an Administrator changes them — the Organizer, Tehnic and every other role refused at each Server Action and again in the service, with nothing written — while the «Ambasador» chip and the «Ambasadori» fold are read by whoever reads the registrations list and by nobody else, and the Organizer is offered none of the presses (2026-11-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the register «Liste date sponsorilor» on an event's registrations page or on «Newsletter», when an Administrator presses «Șterge» beside a list and confirms the question — which names the list by its recipient and day, says nobody is emailed and that the press is for a list made by mistake, which reached nobody — then that list's own audit row is deleted for real, the register on both doors and «Dată partenerilor» of every registration the file held no longer name it, and one row `registrations.sponsor_list_record_deleted` about the same event keeps the list's moment, count and file, never its recipient or a registration's id; the id of any other row of the trail deletes nothing; a second press finds no list; and the press comes back to the register it was pressed in, open (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 14 in where the fold stands. Given an event's registrations page, then «Lista pentru sponsori» — closed, with its line and the register a fold inside it, as before — is drawn below the table of registrations and its batch verbs, the first of the folds there (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event's registrations page, then it draws «Cine s-a înscris», «Caută și filtrează» and the table of registrations in that order with none of the page's other folds between them, and below the table and its batch verbs «Lista pentru sponsori», «Invitații», «Lista internă (doar notițe)», «Elite», «Ambasadori», «Lista oficială de așteptare» and «Emailuri de trimis», in that order, each for the roles it was drawn for before and under the id it had (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Șterge» on a list of the sponsors' register, then only an Administrator deletes — the Organizer, who may take the list and read the register, and every other role are refused at the Server Action and again in the service, with nothing deleted and nothing written — and the two pages hand the register its press only for a role that may delete (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amending criterion 88 in the sentence it quotes. Given an internal event whose window is open and whose «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked, then its card, its page and its register page say «Înscrierile pe site sunt închise momentan.» / “Registration on the site is closed for now.” — or, when the club wrote «Mesaj cât înscrierile pe site sunt oprite» for the event, that sentence in the reader's language in its place, never the other language's and never one of spaces alone; the note is not read while the tick is on, nor for «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», which keeps its own words; and the refusals, the staff verbs and the audit of the tick are as criterion 88 says (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amending criterion 53 in the sentence it quotes. Given an internal event whose window is open and whose «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked, when the calendar feed, the event's `.ics` or Google's add-event link is built, then registration's line is «Înscrierile pe site sunt închise momentan.» / “Registration on the site is closed for now.” — or the club's own sentence for the event in the reader's language, when it wrote one — with no address of the form (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the event editor, then «Mesaj cât înscrierile pe site sunt oprite (opțional)» is one line per language under the tick «Înscrieri publice deschise», at most 200 characters, saved trimmed by the editor's one save and cleared when both are emptied; written in one language alone the save is refused on the empty language's box, whatever the tick says, and nothing is written; a save that posts no such box leaves the note as stored; a series edit carries it to the dates it reaches and a copy keeps it, with the door's switch; and the event file carries a language's note only when the club wrote one, a file made before it importing with none (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event's «Voluntari» card, when whoever manages the volunteers saves «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la» with a whole number above every number a runner of the event wears or may come to wear — a capped race's last number, the desk's spares, a number worn, retired or on the elite list — then the event stores it, every confirmed volunteer without a number is given the next free one from it in the order they were added, and the trail holds the old and the new start and how many numbers were given, never a person; a number at or below the runners' is refused naming the box and nothing is written; an empty box switches the series off, after which nobody draws a number and no number given is taken back (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose volunteers' series is set, when a volunteer is confirmed, then they draw the lowest free number from the series' start under the event row's lock, once — a reopened or already numbered person keeps theirs — and one number is one person at the event: a runner's draw and the desk's hand-typed number treat a volunteer's number as worn, a volunteer's draw steps over every number a runner, an elite line or a desk spare holds, a cancelled volunteer keeps their number and a deleted volunteer's is never drawn again; the number is shown on the person and in the volunteers' CSV and Excel as the column «Număr»; and on real connections racing (`tests/concurrency/volunteer-numbers.test.ts`), twenty volunteers confirmed at the same instant draw twenty different numbers, and «Confirmă» and «Transformă în alergător» pressed on one person at once both go through — the event's row, then the person's, in both — never one aborted by a deadlock (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a real registration that can still be cancelled, when an Administrator presses «Transformă în voluntar» on its page with a role of the event chosen and confirms the question — which names the person, both emails they get («Înscriere anulată», then «Rolul tău de voluntar»), the freed place's offer and a printed bib, and offers «Trimite emailul» for the person's two — then, in one transaction under the event row's lock, the registration is cancelled by the staff cancel with the page's reason and its own audit row, and the person stands on the event's volunteers, entered by the Administrator, confirmed, with that role given, the registered name, the address, the telephone number and the registration's language, and — only while the privacy notice in force names the volunteers' answers — the date of birth, sex, city, club-member tick and shirt size, never a public-list tick; the registration keeps its race number, retired, and the volunteer draws one from the volunteers' series; one audit row `registration.became_volunteer` holds the volunteer's id, the role and the state left, never a name; with «Trimite emailul» unticked neither email is queued and the trail says so. Refused with nothing written: a registration cancelled, expired or never confirmed (CONFLICT), a test one, a person under eighteen on the event's day (`RUNNER_TO_VOLUNTEER_MINOR`), no role or a role of another event (naming the role's box), an address already on the event's volunteers (`VOLUNTEER_ALREADY_LISTED`) (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer who is not cancelled and has an address, on an event that takes registrations on the site and has not started, when an Administrator presses «Transformă în alergător» on the volunteer's page with the two names checked and the relay tick ticked and confirms the question — which names the address and the entry's email by its outcome — then, in one transaction under the event row's lock, the person is entered by the official waiting list's own entry (the address vouched for, no verification email, the row through the one allocator: a counted free place with the declaration theirs to sign, or the back of the waiting list) in the language the volunteer's row holds, and the volunteer is cancelled, keeping the row, its roles and its number; one audit row `volunteer.became_runner` holds the volunteer's id, the registration's and the state it landed in, never a name or an address; nothing the person told the organizers as a volunteer is written onto the registration. Refused with nothing written: the entry without its tick or a name, every refusal of that entry (after the start, a full line, the person already on the address), a cancelled volunteer (CONFLICT), a volunteer with no address (`VOLUNTEER_TO_RUNNER_NEEDS_ADDRESS`), a volunteer of another event (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Transformă în voluntar» and «Transformă în alergător», then neither gives or takes a place except through the verbs that already do: a runner turned volunteer frees their place through the allocator in the same locked transaction — offered to the first on the waiting list or kept free, by the event's setting, never held for the volunteer — and a runner who only waited frees none; a volunteer turned runner takes a counted free place or joins the back of the waiting list, never ahead of anyone already waiting and never a place by itself on a full race; and on real connections racing, five runners of a full race turned into volunteers at once free five places, each offered to one of the five who waited and to nobody twice, with never more places held than the race has (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Transformă în voluntar» and «Transformă în alergător», then only an Administrator presses either — the Organizer, who manages the volunteers, and every other role are refused at the Server Action and again in the service, with nothing written, and the two pages draw the folds for no other role; «Numerele voluntarilor încep de la» is set by whoever manages the volunteers and refused to every other role; and «Lista pentru tombolă» is taken by whoever reads the registrations and works the volunteers — the Organizer and the Administrators — and refused by the route and by the service to every other role and to a request with no session (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event's registrations list with one event chosen, when a role that reads the registrations and works the volunteers follows «Lista pentru tombolă (CSV)», then the file holds one row per number worn at the event — every confirmed real registration with a race number and every confirmed volunteer with a number of the volunteers' series — in the order of the numbers, as three columns in the reader's language: the number, the name, «Alergător» or «Voluntar»; never a registration that waits, is held, cancelled or a test one, a cancelled volunteer, anybody without a number, a line of the elite list or another event's person, and nothing else of a person; every cell is neutralized as the registrations' CSV is; and the download writes one audit row `event.raffle_list_exported` with the two counts and never a name or a number (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a 320-pixel screen, then «Transformă în voluntar» on a registration's page and «Transformă în alergător» on a volunteer's page are closed folds that open onto one form each — the role's select, or the two names and the relay tick, and a button of a thumb's height — their questions fit the screen, and neither page scrolls sideways with its fold open (2026-11-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
